transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, I'm here because of this issue I'm having at work. I work retail, and... the second I even think there might be a bat or something flapping around in the stockroom, my heart just jumps. I start sweating right away, and I just feel like I need to get out of there right then.
Do you only experience this sudden rush of intense fear when thinking about or encountering bats, or does it ever happen completely out of nowhere?

No, it's... it's really just the bats. I don't get that feeling out of nowhere. Like, if I'm just going about my day or at home, I'm completely fine. It only happens when it comes to bats, or, you know, thinking one might be trapped in the store with me.
How long have you been dealing with this intense fear of bats?

It's been going on for about two years now. It started... well, there was this one night I was working a receiving shift, and a bat actually got into the back corridor of the store. Ever since that happened, I've just been dealing with this.
